critical_code_review_comments: post.tsx computeSupervisorWage math verified: h<=1 → 500, h>1 → 500 + (h-1)*250 (e.g. h=2 →750, h=3 →1000, h=5 →1500). Matches UI display.
Wage validation loop (lines 313-325) correctly emits the exact strings 'Enter Daily Wage for Full Trained/Semi Trained/Helper' and 'Enter Supervision Hours for Site Supervisor'.
PDF MIME check on line 217-222 accepts application/pdf OR filename ending .pdf (handles Android application/octet-stream case) — good.

File size /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/post.tsx is 1240 lines — >700 threshold. Recommend main agent extract SectionCard, SegmentBtn, SkillRow, DrawingChooserModal, and location block into separate components in a future refactor pass (not blocking).
post.tsx uses expo-image-picker MediaTypeOptions.Images which is deprecated in SDK 51+; not fixed in this iteration but flagged.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ jobs via API/UI as Client (9000000001). Not cleaned — cosmetic clutter only; test titles prefixed 'TEST_' or match 'Mason' for filtering.
context_for_next_testing_agent: React Native Field/Input in this app renders testID directly on the <input> or <textarea> element itself (no wrapper). So use selector '[data-testid="xxx"]' for page.fill / input_value — NOT '[data-testid="xxx"] input'. sk-super-total-site-supervisor renders '₹500' / '₹750' / '₹1,000' / '₹1,500'. Login via urllib to /api/auth/login returns 403 from the container's outbound network — use page.evaluate(fetch(...)) inside browser context and stash token in localStorage under 'bm_token' as JSON.stringify(token) (storage layer JSON-parses on read).
